colava•IT

Cookies & preferences

Simple controls for the functions actually present.

No integrated tracking

COLAVA page code sets no analytics or advertising cookies and embeds no third-party video or social widgets. The banner lets you choose whether to remember language; it does not enable advertising tools.

What is stored

colava-privacy-v1: preferences choice and expiry, in localStorage for 180 days. colava-language: IT or EN language, only when requested and while the preferences choice remains valid. Data stays in the browser and COLAVA code does not send it to a server.

Changing your choice

Open “Manage preferences” in the footer. “Essential only” disables language persistence and removes the saved language. The IT/EN switch continues to work while browsing.

Hosting and links

The hosting service or its restricted access may use its own technical mechanisms. COLAVA preferences do not control those services or cookies on external websites opened through links.

Reference

Italian Data Protection Authority guidance on cookies and tracking. Updated: 20 September 2026.
